name: Paperless-ngx
description: Finds documents in Paperless-ngx for AI clients: a full-text search, and the invoices, manuals and warranty papers of an entry (searched by its serial number, model and name). Documents stay in Paperless-ngx; nothing is imported or changed, and the tools return title, correspondent, document type, creation date, tags and a link to the document, not its content. Settings: url (the address of Paperless-ngx, e.g. https://paperless.example.org) and token (the API auth token of a Paperless-ngx user; results are limited to the documents this user may see, so a user with view rights only is enough). Reads entries only to build the search for paperless.for_entry.

mcpTools.name: paperless.search
mcpTools.description: Full-text search in Paperless-ngx. Returns documents with title, correspondent, document type, creation date, tags and a link to the document in Paperless-ngx.

mcpTools.name: paperless.for_entry
mcpTools.description: Paperless-ngx documents about one entry (invoices, manuals, warranty papers), found by its serial number, model and name.
